tasks.gr7-novel-short-story-study-t1: Topic: Novel or short story study. Cover character, plot, conflict, setting, theme, and literary features. Ask Grade 7 learners to identify core elements, sequence events, infer character motivation, and justify answers with evidence from short narrative extracts.
tasks.gr7-review-essay-writing-t1: Topic: Review and essay writing. Cover review format, narrative and reflective essays, planning, drafting, and paragraph unity. Ask Grade 7 learners to choose suitable structures, audience-aware tone, and effective conclusions while recognising strong editing decisions.
tasks.gr7-foundational-grammar-context-t1: Topic: Foundational grammar in context. Cover singular and plural forms, verb tense control, word order, and direct and indirect speech. Ask Grade 7 learners to correct sentence errors, transform speech forms, and apply grammar accurately in short contextual items.
